item.title: Four-legged first responder: LONDON joins WFD crisis response dog team
item.description: WILMINGTON, NC (WWAY-TV) – The Wilmington Fire Department added a new four-legged team member to its crew on Tuesday. LONDON is a one and half year old black lab and he’s a new “Crisis Response Facility Dog” at the fire department. item.title: Wilmington celebrates the life of civil rights leader Bertha Todd
item.description: WILMINGTON, NC (WWAY-TV) – Longtime educator and civil rights activist Bertha Boykin Todd died two weeks ago at the age of 96. Her celebration of life was on Tuesday at the Macedonia Missionary Baptist Church in Wilmington. Todd served on an advisory board to former Governor James Hunt early in his administration. item.title: Jimmy’s bar hosts annual bike drive to donate bikes to children in need
item.description: NEW HANOVER COUNTY (WWAY) — Jimmy’s bar in Wrightsville Beach hosted a bike drive to donate new bikes to children in need, and the new wheels rolled out in droves. This year was the eighth year of Jimmy’s bike drive. All the bikes that were donated will be given to schools, charities, and children’s homes. item.title: Utility construction sparks worries about live oak tree damage on Salisbury Street
item.description: NEW HANOVER COUNTY (WWAY) — Years old live oak trees line Salisbury Street on both sides of Harbor Island. Cape Fear Public Utility Authority has begun trenching, starting on Eastwood, across Trask bridge, and onto Salisbury Street to place a new water main. item.title: Border Patrol official who is the face of Trump’s crackdown back in Chicago amid immigration raids
item.description: Senior Border Patrol official Greg Bovino returned to the Chicago area on Tuesday, about a month after leaving to lead immigration enforcements in other cities, immigration advocates say.

item.title: Doctor who helped sell ketamine to actor Matthew Perry before his overdose death avoids prison time
item.description: A doctor who pleaded guilty in a scheme to supply ketamine to actor Matthew Perry before his overdose death was sentenced Tuesday to 8 months of home confinement.

item.title: Columbus County Sheriffs are searching for a 15-year old girl
item.description: The Columbus County Sheriff’s Office is actively conducting a search and rescue operation for 15-year-old Jettie Edwards, who has autism.

item.title: Hoggard beats WPA 65-39, remains undefeated
item.description: Hoggard girls basketball improved to 8-0 on Tuesday with a 65-39 home win over Wilson Prep Academy.

item.title: The scams Christmas shoppers need to watch out for this year
item.description: Some of the most popular scams from last year include misleading social media ads, social media gift exchanges that act like pyramid schemes, and holiday apps, which can have hidden purchases inside them.
